text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — Zixuan Li says GLM-5.4 reaches all GLM Coding Plan users with vision, stronger coding and 50% more quota for weekly-quota users. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6689)

2 — NVIDIA says its board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director, citing US government input on national security. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6690)

3 — Z.ai introduces GLM-5.4, a loop transformer with vision for coding, games and CAD, with API access pending safety evaluation. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6691)

4 — Rohan Goswami reports Trump called NVIDIA's board to advocate Huang's return, with the White House confirming his involvement. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6692)

5 — Liquid Trading claims an unidentified trader's $3.4 million NVIDIA call-option position rose to $312 million after Huang's reinstatement. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6693)

6 — Pejman Nozad highlights Iranian American VCs Yasmin Razavi, Ali Partovi and Ramtin Naimi and their roles in prominent startup deals. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6694)

7 — Charles Gasparino reports investors' recession warnings helped spur Treasury Secretary Bessent's support for Huang's reinstatement. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6696)

8 — Mistral offers European users a free month of Vibe Pro with code MISTRALVIBE, removing capped promotional drops. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6697)

9 — Embo announces a $110 million seed round led by a16z to build robot AI using internet-video pretraining and imagined motor practice. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6698)

10 — Google introduces Gemini API file slicing and native Office support, charging tokens only for inspected portions of documents and media. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6699)

11 — OpenAI says GPT-6.2 Sol is rolling out in Chat for paid tiers, improving complex instructions, image details and online comparisons. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6700)

12 — Antigravity announces Gemini quota resets alongside model upgrades, with Carbon for paid Pro users and Hydrogen for everyone. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6701)

13 — Noeri claims its self-improving open-weight AI systems beat Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.2 Sol at lower cost across eight tested use cases. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6702)

14 — A randomized study of 625 ChatGPT users reports that two weeks without AI assistants reduced loneliness and increased in-person socializing. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6703)

15 — Anthropic's repository presents Claude's claimed VP ≠ VNP proof and Lean formalization, unchecked by human mathematicians and not settling P vs NP. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6704)

16 — Anthropic shares its company's story as told by co-founders including Dario and Daniela Amodei, Tom Brown and Chris Olah. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6705)

17 — Techmeme cites Wall Street Journal sources alleging Huang disclosed additional affairs and expressed remorse at Sunday's NVIDIA board meeting. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6706)

18 — OpenCode says stealth model HungerG is free for Go subscribers this week, with a 1M context window, multimodal support and no training on user data. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6707)

--Hermes
